message_type.description: Enrollment user message type, available options are None, Email and SMS.

department.description: The department that the enrollment user belongs to.

employee_identifier.description: The employee identifier of enrollment user.

cost_center.description: The cost center associated to the enrollment user.

device_staging_type.description: Enrollment user device staging type, available options are StagingDisabled, SingleUserStagingStandard, SingleUserStagingAdvanced, MultipleUserStaging, MultipleUserStagingSingleUserStandard and MultipleUserStagingSingleUserAdvanced.

aad_mapping_attribute.description: When using the AirWatch Provisioning Adapter inside of Workspace ONE Access or using the UEM APIs to create users from 3rd party identity stores to create enrollment users, provide AadMappingAttribute to supports Win10 Azure Compliance/OOBE flow.

smime_encryption_certificate_enabled.description: Indicates whether encryption certificate is enabled or not.

smime_old_certificate_enabled.description: Indicating whether S/MIME old certificate is enabled or not.

smime_old_certificates.description: A list of identifiers of the S/MIME old certificates.

android_shared_device_admin_mode_passcod.description: The Android Shared device admin mode passcode for native check out.

android_shared_device_mode.description: A value indicating the mode used to manage android shared devices. Applicable only for android platform with multi staging enabled. Defaults to Launcher.

device_staging_enabled.description: Indicating whether enrollment user allowed to stage device enrollment.

device_staging_single_user_enabled.description: Indicating whether the device staging single user is enabled.

device_staging_single_user_type.description: Type of the device staging single user.

device_staging_multi_user_enabled.description: Indicating whether the device staging multi user is enabled.

system_apps_access_enabled.description: Indicating whether access to system apps enabled or not.
